items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: Buddy Manatee played. Those old guys hanging around Renfort Street, he played bass. ... I knew him.

ctx.x: That would be a string band?

That would be a string band. Well you used to use the violin you know, violin is a leader, you used to use the violin as a leader and you had your cornet, a very youth trumpet at that time. It was cornet, there was trombone, clarinet, guitar, then later on came in the banjo. And the guitar was full. Buddy Manatee played. Those old guys hanging around Renfort Street, he played bass. They had a bass? Bob Lyons maybe? Bob Lyons. Bob Lyons. They played bass and also guitar. I knew him. Would they have a drummer in…

Is there any band you can think of that would sound or any music you can think of that would sound something like that music then? I mean was it was it a different sound then to some of these jazz bands they have now? Or would it be about the same?
